description: This file declares wrapper classes for Metal's MTLTexture and MTLBuffer, including resource management, creation, and synchronization methods for Metal graphics resources within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: Manages GPU resource usage, including tracking command buffer serials and memory dirtiness.

classes.name: Texture
classes.description: Represents a Metal texture resource with methods for creation, modification, and synchronization.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Represents a Metal buffer resource with methods for creation, mapping, and resizing.

methods.name: Make2DTexture
methods.description: Creates a 2D Metal texture with specified parameters.

methods.name: MakeCubeTexture
methods.description: Creates a cube Metal texture with specified parameters.

methods.name: MakeFromMetal
methods.description: Creates a Texture object from an existing Metal MTLTexture.

methods.name: replaceRegion
methods.description: Replaces a region of the texture with provided pixel data.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Reads pixel data from the texture.

methods.name: createCubeFaceView
methods.description: Creates a view of a cube face.

methods.name: createSliceMipView
methods.description: Creates a view of a specific slice and mip level.

methods.name: pixelFormat
methods.description: Returns the pixel format of the texture.

methods.name: mipmapLevels
methods.description: Returns the number of mipmap levels.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the texture at a specific mip level.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the texture at a specific mip level.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size (extents) of the texture at a specific mip level or image index.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or replaces the underlying Metal texture object.

methods.name: syncContent
methods.description: Synchronizes texture content between CPU and GPU.

methods.name: MakeBuffer
methods.description: Creates a Metal buffer with specified size and data.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the buffer memory for CPU access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the buffer memory after CPU access.
